name: minimal-agent
description: Umbrella monorepo: git submodules for minimal-agent-core + minimal-agent-plugins.

scripts.install:all: bun install --cwd minimal-agent-core && bun install --cwd minimal-agent-plugins
scripts.test: bun run --cwd minimal-agent-core test && bun run --cwd minimal-agent-plugins test
scripts.check: bun run --cwd minimal-agent-core check && bun run --cwd minimal-agent-plugins check
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd minimal-agent-core typecheck && bun run --cwd minimal-agent-plugins typecheck
